items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: Did you know that the guy that made the most records of anybody, do you know what his name is? The orchestra? Bob Haring, H-a-r-i-n-g.

ctx.x: Yeah. Where are they published and by whom, the discographies?

Well, one guy is in Florida. He's also putting out bootleg records at this time. And this other is a regular, handsomely bound, there's two books, they're quite thick, and I got them -- I noticed them advertised in one of the book things that we get in the mail, and it has every band that ever recorded anything, except that it does not cover jazz. They do not cover Duke in there, they do not cover Basie. In other words, what they call

out and out jazz bands. They -- it also says in there that these have been covered very thoroughly elsewhere. But there's all sorts of bands there. Did you know that the guy that made the most records of anybody, do you know what his name is? The orchestra? Bob Haring, H-a-r-i-n-g.
